messages:
sam: FYI ACME reported embeddings latency spike a few minutes ago, vectors/sec dropped ~40% while tokens/sec looks normal. ticket #3421. Anyone else seeing this?

mike: I pulled traces — requests show a bunch of dim=1536 payloads hitting an endpoint backed by a 1024-dim model variant. That would cause extra work in the runtime and weird batching behavior.

jess: Infra: GPU queue depth on ded-gpu-pool-1 jumped to 85% at the same time, batch windows increased from ~12ms to ~65ms. kvcache eviction rate spiked too.

sam: Repro attempt (from curl we got from customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-v2","input":["a","b"],"dimension":1536}'
```
The customer SDK sent a `dimension` field. Most normal clients don't.

mike: That matches — our variant selector landed embed-v2-large (1536) in the canary pool earlier today. It seems rollout included a variant that is incompatible with the pinned 1024-serving runtime in some hosts. We should reject mismatched dims at the API layer.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout `embed-v2-large` started 2024-06-12T07:05:12Z, affected hosts: ded-gpu-pool-1 (20%).

jess: Mitigation plan enacted: routing 100% away from ded-gpu-pool-1 for embed-v2 requests, and reduced max_batch_size -> 8 and max_batch_tokens -> 2048 cluster-wide to lower queue growth. Applied at 07:25 UTC.

sam: Sending status to customer: temporary routing + throttling applied, investigating root cause and repro steps.

mike: Root cause: rollout config lacked a dimension compatibility check. We have two immediate fixes: 1) API-level validation to reject requests whose declared/implicit dim doesn't match chosen model variant; 2) rollout rollback of embed-v2-large until we add strict validation.

oncall: I'm on it. I'll push hotfix to API validation (reject+400) and start rollback if validation can't be deployed within 3 hours. Will update in this thread.

sam: Quick customer-facing workaround: ask clients to omit dimension field or pin model to `embed-v2-1024`. I'll draft copy.

mike: Also adding a telemetry check to alert when tokens/sec vs vectors/sec diverge > 20% for a model — will make future detection automatic.

jess: Post-mitigation metrics look better: queue depth down to baseline in the last 3 minutes, GPU utilization falling back to ~45%.

oncall: Hotfix deployed (api-validate-dim v1). New behaviour: if client dim != model.dim -> 400 + help text. Rolling to 50% now, full deploy in 15m.

sam: Great. I informed the customer and marked ticket #3421 as escalated -> engineering hotfix. Will keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
